description: This PHP source file defines the SmsClient class within the Aws\Sms namespace. It extends the AwsClient class and includes method annotations for various operations related to the AWS Server Migration Service, such as creating, deleting, retrieving, and updating applications and replication jobs. The file acts as a client interface for interacting with the AWS SMS service, providing method signatures for asynchronous and synchronous API calls.
